column1: 2.3.2.5 Servo Drive Assembly (2-Axis). The Two-axis servo consists of two units as
a pair – one on Starboard side and other on Port side. These units carry electronic
payloads. Purpose of TAS is to move these payloads in azimuth and elevation axis. Both
the units have common ‘Home’ reference i.e. bow of the ship as ‘0’. Unit on starboard side
can rotate from 350 to +190 in azimuth, whereas unit on port side rotate from 170 to
+10 in azimuth. Thus together these two units provide 360º coverage for tracking and an
overlap angle of 10 in both -clockwise and anti-clockwise direction. Block diagram and
